description: Use this when someone asks to send a WhatsApp message from one of their Wapiworld numbers. Returns only that Wapiworld accepted the send, not proof of delivery. The message goes out immediately, each call sends another copy, and recording settings may store its text. Not for broadcasts or bulk sends.

chatId.description: Exact recipient phone number in international format (for example +1234567890) or exact WhatsApp chat id. Show it to the user before requesting confirmation.

content.description: Exact text message to send, maximum 4096 characters. Show the complete text before confirmation. Do not send credentials, PHI, PCI cardholder data, government identifiers, or other restricted data.

instanceId.description: Sender instance id, shown to the user before confirmation

name: send_message

status.description: Wapiworld accepted the send for transport; not proof of delivery or reading

title: Send WhatsApp message
